assessment_details.rationale: Rank-local CPO transport is concrete continual-learning engineering that could matter if O adopts large distributed regularizer-based adaptation, but generation-25 is currently dominated by execution/recovery control rather than model-training memory.
O is actively repairing a stalled execution path; the finding that noisy hard alarms spend most time in defensive mode directly informs watchdog trigger design and false-positive recovery cost.
The fixed-reserve benchmark is useful for robust resource allocation under uncertainty, but its particle-specific transient hedge requires substantial adaptation.
Separating frequency calibration from per-run guarantees is directly useful for O's monitors/evaluators so calibrated aggregate coverage is not mistaken for dispatch-time safety.
Continuous risk-budget modulation rather than binary cooldown is useful for O recovery economics, though genealogy itself is domain-specific.
Forward-only replay authorization maps directly to O's frozen Work requests, deterministic replay boundaries and current recovery correctness requirements.
Versioned runtime-provenance admission is highly relevant to O's generation/fence/model/source bindings and restart-sensitive Work execution.
Fail-closed provenance auditing before reconciliation directly targets O's current recovery/refire path, where a mismatched runtime binding must not be silently repaired.
O already relies on pre-dispatch revocation checks; HALO's stale-after-admission evidence directly tests the remaining final-effect race and one-dispatch authority semantics.

Dependency-aware partial retention is useful when O must preserve unaffected work while invalidating stale dependent context/actions instead of globally restarting or independently keeping unsafe children.
Effect-semantic permission coverage is directly relevant because O's safety depends on action identity and target state, not merely which connector/tool primitive expressed the mutation.

O's engineering discipline explicitly distinguishes configured safeguards from executed evidence; this failure mode is immediately relevant to avoiding false confidence during current exact-head recovery validation.

O's Context Kernel carries derived context across tool lifecycles; adaptive metadata-field attacks and revocation residue are directly relevant to contamination and invalidation boundaries even though the browser setting differs.
Trusted effect-bound approval rendering is relevant to O's smartphone/account-holder approvals and action authorization, especially when agent-authored summaries could diverge from the actual effect.
Agent-first interfaces can reduce retries and human intervention before higher-level recovery; that directly targets O's expected-time objective and current task-chat/tool recovery bottleneck.

The large GPT-5.4 disruption from always-on safety review makes reviewer cadence a first-class concern for O's monitor/critic architecture: rescue must be weighed against solved-to-unsolved disruption.

Identical-failed-prefix rewind evidence is directly relevant to O's checkpoint recovery, logical context resets and cause-repair loop, while highlighting the need to factor rollback target and carry-forward guidance.
Blast-radius-sensitive conservative promotion directly maps to O's protected-regression risk: high-impact canonical corrections should demand stronger residual evidence or remain provisional.
The explicit correlated-family audit is conceptually useful for misspecification detection but remains a synthetic restless-bandit model with weak direct fit to O's software control path.
A semantic-invariance gate across plausible model families is a transferable abstention principle for O's causal/source judgments, though implementation would require a different uncertainty model.
Tri-state durable persistence evidence is useful for replay/idempotency correctness, but O's current authority is primarily Git/CAS rather than rotating local event-log generations.
The corrected Lean routing number is useful evidence-hygiene and external-routing context, but it changes an external quantitative estimate more than O's immediate implementation choice.
Constraining what an oracle actually covers directly protects O from overreading controller headroom and supports current expected-time strategy reviews.
Verifier-grounded trajectory features and explicit cost scope are directly relevant to learning when one more attempt/evaluation is worth buying in O's Work loop.
Retained verified baseline plus optional challenger strongly matches O's reversible Candidate/strategy replacement policy and protected-regression requirement.
The preregistered incremental-over-baseline OOD/uncertainty gates are directly useful for O's held-out strategy scheduler and avoiding learned controllers that add no value beyond the incumbent.
Evidential-risk-aware experiment design complements O's information-value objective by pricing the probability of misleading evidence, not just mean information gain.
Discrepancy-gated multi-fidelity allocation maps directly to O's need to route between cheap broad evidence and costly trusted evidence based on measured mismatch rather than a fixed mixture.

LOGOS's separated proposal/selection/certification/report surfaces, bounded gate exposure and online error accounting are highly relevant to safe O self-improvement and truthful long-horizon candidate admission.
